High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:149550
(Sl.No.3011) 
Court No. - 79
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 20793 of 2019
Applicant :- Kapil Mishra And 6 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar Rai
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Saurabh Trivedi
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

Heard Sri Pradeep Kumar Rai, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Saurabh Trivedi, learned
counsel appearing on behalf of opposite party No.2 and Sri Prem Prakash Tiwari, learned Aga for
the State.

2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants seeking
quashing of the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.2352 of 2019 (State vs. Kapil Mishra and
others) arising out of Case Crime No.328 of 2005 under Sections 498A, 307, 328, 504, 506 Ipc and
Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Sadar Bazar, District-Meerut, pending in the court of
Acjm-Vii, Meerut.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that vide order dated 27.5.2019, the parties were directed to approach the trial court for verification of the compromise arrived at between the parties Kapil Mishra And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88563352/
1 and as per the report received from the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.7, Meerut dated 6.7.2019, the compromise between the parties has duly been verified by the trial court.

entities.text: Kapil Mishra And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, it was stated that one witness, namely, Laxmi Shankar Mishra had died, therefore, his statement was not recorded during verification of the compromise.

Learned counsel for the applicants further submits that in terms of the settlement between applicant No.1 and sister of opposite party No.2 are living as husband and wife and out of the said wedlock, there are two children.

Learned counsel for the applicants further submits that after filing of the charegesheet in the instant case, the applicants had filed an application u/S 482 Cr.P.C. No.7033 of 2006, thereupon the parties had settled their dispute amicably and the applicant No.1 and his wife are residing together as husband and wife and, therefore, the said application was withdrawn by the applicants and the instant application has been filed subsequently on the basis of settlement/compromise executed between the parties for quashing of the entire proceedings and thereafter the instant application was filed seeking quashing of the entire proceedings of the instant case on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
An affidavit was also filed by the opposite party No.2 supporting the prayers made by the applicant for quashing of the entire proceedings of the case on the basis of the compromise.

Though, in the instant proceedings, the charge-sheet was initially filed on the basis of suspected poisoning, however, subsequent thereto except the suspected poisoning,
no proof of poisoning as such was found during the investigation.

4. In view thereof, since it was a matrimonial dispute between the parties, which had arisen in the year 2005 and subsequent thereto the matter was settled and the parties are residing as husband and wife and there are children out of the said wedlock after the subsequent settlement and after lodging of the instant case by the opposite party No.2.
5.

The aforesaid facts are not disputed by learned counsel for the opposite party No.2.
6.

Learned AGA also submits that since it was a matrimonial dispute, which has amicably settled and the compromise was also verified and the parties are residing together, therefore, he does not oppose the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of the instant case.

7. Having regard to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, since the parties have already settled all their disputes amicably out of the court and a compromise was also executed between the parties which has been duly verified by the trial court and in terms of the compromise, the parties are living together as husband and wife and children had also born out of the said wedlock after compromise between the parties, thus, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the instant criminal proceeding pending between the parties.

Therefore, the instant application is allowed in terms of the compromise, which has been duly verified by the trial court concerned and the entire criminal proceedings of Criminal Case No.2352 of 2019 (State vs. Kapil Mishra and others) arising out of Case Crime No.328 of 2005 under Sections 498A, 307, 328, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Sadar Bazar, District-Meerut, pending in the court of ACJM-VII, Meerut,
are hereby quashed in the light of the judgments of the Apex Court in The State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Laxmi Narayan : 2019 (2) SCC (Crl) 706, Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab and Another : (2012) 10 SCC 303; Prabatbhai Aahir Alias Prabatbhai Bhimsinghbhai Karmur and others vs. State of Gujarat and Another : (2017) 9 SCC 641; Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab : (2014) 6 SCC 466 and Kapil Mishra And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88563352/
2 B.S. Joshi and others vs. State of Haryana and Another : (2003) 4 SCC 67.
